Hi,

Kindly enable supply for Gen AI Engineer role.

Role: Gen AI Engineer
Band: E3 7+ Years
Budget : SF ID: 129013
Locations: Bangalore / Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune

Skills: Gen AI, Agentic AI, Python
Key Responsibilities
At least 5 years of experience designing and implementing artificial intelligence systems.
- Strong experience with machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision technologies.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, and C++.
- Experience working with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Strong leadership skills and ability to mentor other members of the AI development team.
- Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch.
- Experience with distributed computing systems such as Hadoop or Spark.
- Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
- Experience with agile software development methodologies.
